methods.name: Hash::hash_slice default and API caveat
methods.behavior: The trait documents hash_slice semantics as unspecified generally. This pinned default visits each element and calls piece.hash(state); HttpDate does not override it.

methods.name: Hasher::write_u16 default
methods.behavior: Forwards the native-endian bytes to write(&i.to_ne_bytes()).

finding: In both pinned sources, inherent Formatter::write_str and the fmt::Write trait implementation independently forward to the formatter buffer's write_str. The trait implementation does not call the inherent method.
hash_review: Both core revisions define Hash::hash_slice's default as a loop calling Hash::hash per element, while documenting the method's general semantics as unspecified. Primitive u8/u16 Hash methods call write_u8/write_u16, while primitive slice overrides write raw bytes. HttpDate now has a manual Hash implementation with the same seven typed fields and does not override hash_slice, so the default per-item behavior applies to HttpDate slices in these source revisions.
default_hasher_review: In both pinned std sources, DefaultHasher::new constructs SipHasher13 with fixed keys (0, 0); its write and finish methods delegate to that local state. The pinned core SipHasher implementation initializes, updates, and finishes that state without consulting an RNG or process-global state. DefaultHasher hashes are not promised stable across Rust releases; the test only compares fresh hashers under the same pinned runtime and does not assume an injective or universally faithful trace.
scope_note: These line references and source hashes document implementation review only. They do not prove the Rust standard library or establish behavior beyond the pinned source revisions.
error_review: The application explicit source/cause/description preserve reviewed standard defaults. Direct concrete Error+Send+Sync payload conversion boxes and retains the supplied value and kind; arbitrary Into converters and dynamic payload observers remain outside the formal model.
debug_review: Pinned source references for reviewing Rust Debug formatting behavior used by the model. Source inspection and native differential tests do not prove equivalence to std implementations.

macos_platform_review.note: Reviewed pinned native and translation Rust time sources; conditional model applicability only.
